title: turkish hand towels
text: turkish hand towels. I am using these as washable arm covers on my brand new recyliner.  They are soft, thick and perfect for protection from body oils and other stains on my new chair.  Wash up beautifully.  True medium gray... not taupe or green - in my opinion.

product_metadata.title: Chakir Turkish Linens 100% Cotton Premium Turkish Towels for Bathroom | 16'' x 30'' (6- Piece Hand Towel - Cranberry)
features: HIGH-QUALITY TOWELS: These towels are crafted in Turkey with quality cotton that makes them absorbent, soft, and fluffy. These towels fluff up after the first wash, which allows you to feel spa grandeur in the comfort of your own home. The double-stitched hem and natural weave guarantee durability and strength.
OUR DIFFERENCE: Our Premium towels are crafted in Denizli, Turkey, where years of experience culminate to make quality towels you can rely on out of Premium Cotton that speaks for its self.
SET INCLUDES: This towel set consists of 6 hand towels sized 16in. X 30in. These excellent and functional measurements are ideal for the everyday purposes of these towels.

ECO-FRIENDLY: Our towels are made from quality 100% cotton. We avoid dangerous chemicals /softeners in the manufacturing process and try to make the premium cotton and Turkish Craftmanship speak for its self.

CARE TIPS: Machine washable towels. We recommend washing in cold water before your first use. This allows the premium cotton fibers to open up and give the towels better absorbency. Tumble dry on low heat or hang them to dry. Please don’t use fabric softener, dry sheets, and/or bleach. Chemicals will only reduce the softness of the material.
description: These high-quality hotel and spa collection towels are now available to you! Made from 100% long stable, super absorbent and natural Turkish cotton, our towels will give you the feel of luxury comfort. Chakir Linen towels will give your bathroom the aura of being in a beautiful resort, because of its relaxing touch after a long and stressful day.  We have been manufacturing Turkish towels for over 20 years and we are experts in our craft of producing high quality cotton towels and pride ourselves on only making the finest.
THE DIFFERENCE IN OUR TURKISH TOWELS!

PREMIUM TURKISH COTTON!  Turkish cotton is a premium cotton that has extra-long fibers, which makes Turkish towels delightfully absorbent! These towels are also known to become softer, fluffier, and more absorbent with each wash due to its unique material.  The double-stitched hem and the natural weave on our towels guarantee durability and strength.  Our towels are free from harmful chemicals and are safe for you and the environment.

STEP 1: Wash towels in cold water before first use (The cold first wash will open up the fibers to make it plusher) We recommend that you soak the towels in cold water for 12 hours and then hang them to dry for maximum absorbency and softness. Please AVOID fabric softener, dryer sheets and/or bleach as the chemicals will only reduce the softness of the towels.  Step 1 is not to be repeated afterwards just continue step 2!  STEP 2: Tumble dry towels on low heat.

You will love the soft, luxurious feel and the quality of first-rate luxury hotel and spa collection towels. If 100% satisfaction is not met our customer service team would be happy to hear your concerns.
